findings.note: English is 'Image {index} of {count}' but the value drops 图片, and since remove/retry interpolate it as {label} the composed tooltips read '移除第 2 张，共 3 张' (remove no. 2, 3 in all) with no object; the spaces around the digit placeholders also break the binding style-guide rule (no space between CJK and digit runs) that the same delta follows in in_message/limit ('#张图片') and the namespace follows everywhere else ('{count}条未读', '最后回复于{time}'). Give open the same shape: '打开第{index}张图片（共{count}张）'. aria-label/title only, so no width risk.

findings.proposed: 此文件不是可发送的图片。请使用PNG、JPEG、WebP或GIF格式。
findings.note: Spaces around Latin runs break the style-guide rule and this namespace's practice ('按Enter发送', '正在检查Team Bridge……'). The bare format list after 使用 is also a calque of 'Use PNG…': Chinese needs the noun 格式. Same spacing fix for error_offline: '无法连接Local Operator，图片未能上传。恢复连接后请重试。' (the locale writes Local Operator with no spaces 38 times and with spaces only twice).

findings.current: 此图片已无法发送。请将其移除；如果仍显示预览，可以重试。
findings.proposed: 此图片已无法发送。请将其移除；如果重试按钮仍在，也可以重试。
findings.note: The translation makes the retry condition 'the preview is still shown', which the English does not say, and in the code it can be false: Retry appears only when bytes are in memory ({failed && chip.prepared}), but a draft restored in the same app session gets a preview from the uploadPreview LRU without prepared, so a preview can show with no retry button. The English 'retry if it’s still shown' is ambiguous at the source, so the coder should also add a context note saying that 'it' is the Retry control.

In English the plural 'images' carries the 'every image' meaning; Chinese has no plural, so '移除图片' reads as removing one image, while this ghost button in the reschedule dialog clears all of them. The locale already writes '移除所有标签' for the parallel tags action. 12 cells against 13 English characters, so it still fits.

This is a single U+2026, but the style guide sets the ellipsis to …… and the three sibling loading strings in this file use it (identity_loading, plan.checking, schedule.loading). It is a NIT because the value only renders as Spinner sr-only text and inside the chip aria-label.

validation.typography: The file is NFC, has no BOM, ends with a newline, and contains no U+200E/F, U+202A–E, U+2066–9 or U+061C. Prose uses full-width ，。；、. Short labels (add, strip, expired, unavailable, retry_load, remove_all) have no sentence-final 。. Full sentences end in 。.
